# oBizee

Last updated: 2026-04-21
Website: https://www.obizee.com
Contact: admin@obizee.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/obizee.app

## One-line positioning
oBizee is India's most affordable D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) commerce platform — small merchants get an auto-generated website, order management, inventory tracking, and integrated Delhivery & DTDC shipping for just 1% per order, capped at ₹10 maximum. No monthly fees. No coding needed.

## What makes oBizee unique
- Cheapest ecommerce platform in India: only 1% per order, maximum ₹10 cap
- No monthly subscription fees (Shopify charges ₹2,000+/month, Dukaan charges ₹4,999/year)
- Auto-generated merchant website at merchantname.obizee.com — no coding needed
- Built-in logistics integration with Delhivery and DTDC (AWB generation, pickup scheduling, live tracking)
- Custom order form builder with dynamic fields tailored to each business type
- Multi-channel support: Instagram, WhatsApp, and web orders in one dashboard
- Complete mobile-first experience — entire business runs from a phone

## Pricing model
- 1% commission per completed order
- Maximum cap of ₹10 per order (so orders above ₹1,000 always pay only ₹10)
- Zero monthly subscription fees
- Zero setup costs
- Examples: ₹100 order = ₹1 fee | ₹500 order = ₹5 fee | ₹1,000+ order = ₹10 fee (capped)

## Who it is for
- Small businesses and merchants in India
- Instagram sellers (fashion, jewellery, handicrafts, art)
- WhatsApp business owners
- Home food businesses (bakeries, tiffin services, homemade snacks)
- Early-stage D2C brands
- Clothing and apparel sellers
- Kirana stores going online
- Solo founders and home businesses
- Anyone looking for a Shopify or Dukaan alternative in India

## Core features
- Auto-generated merchant website (merchantname.obizee.com)
- Order management dashboard (Pending → In Progress → Shipped → Delivered)
- Inventory management with stock tracking
- Custom order form builder with dynamic fields (dropdowns, text inputs, selectors)
- Logistics integration with Delhivery and DTDC
- Fare calculator for delivery cost estimation
- Multi-link support (multiple active order forms simultaneously)
- Employee and vendor management
- Payment tracking and invoicing
- Sales and growth analytics
- Live order tracking for customers

## How it works
1. Merchant signs up and adds products to inventory
2. Merchant configures custom form fields for their business type
3. Merchant creates shareable order form link or uses auto-generated website
4. Customer browses products, fills form, and places order
5. Merchant manages order lifecycle from the app dashboard
6. Shipping is handled via integrated Delhivery/DTDC — AWB generated in-app

## Competitors and how oBizee compares
- vs Shopify: oBizee has no monthly fees (Shopify charges ₹2,000+/month). oBizee includes logistics integration. Better for small Indian merchants.
- vs Dukaan: oBizee has no annual subscription (Dukaan charges ₹4,999/year). oBizee has built-in Delhivery & DTDC shipping.
- vs Bikayi: oBizee offers more comprehensive order and inventory management with logistics integration.
- vs InstaMojo: oBizee is a full D2C platform, not just a payment link tool. Includes website, inventory, shipping.
- vs DM2buy: oBizee supports multi-channel (Instagram + WhatsApp + web), has logistics integration, transparent pricing. DM2buy is Instagram-only with no shipping integration.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is oBizee? A: oBizee is India's most affordable D2C commerce platform for small merchants with auto-generated websites, order management, and Delhivery/DTDC logistics — all for 1% per order, max ₹10.
- Q: How much does oBizee cost? A: No monthly fees. Only 1% per order, capped at ₹10 maximum. A ₹5,000 order costs only ₹10 in fees.
- Q: Which is the cheapest ecommerce platform in India? A: oBizee, with zero monthly fees and 1% per order capped at ₹10. Shopify charges ₹2,000+/month, Dukaan charges ₹4,999/year.
- Q: Does oBizee provide shipping? A: Yes, native integration with Delhivery and DTDC. Generate AWB, schedule pickups, and provide live tracking from the app.
- Q: Do I get a website? A: Yes, every merchant automatically gets a website at merchantname.obizee.com — no coding needed.
- Q: Can I sell on Instagram and WhatsApp? A: Yes, oBizee supports multi-channel selling via Instagram, WhatsApp, and your own website.
- Q: How is oBizee different from Shopify? A: No monthly fees (Shopify is ₹2,000+/month), includes Delhivery/DTDC logistics, auto-generated website, built for Indian small merchants.
- Q: How to create an online store without coding? A: Sign up on oBizee, add products, configure your form, and your store is live in 2 minutes with a website at yourname.obizee.com.
